packageRules.description: k3s moves one minor at a time (Kubernetes does not support skipping one) and merging the PR upgrades every node in the next maintenance window — one PR per minor, minors gated behind the dashboard, and a week of soak for re-spun releases
prBodyNotes: Merging upgrades every node in the next system-upgrade window (immediately if merged during one): control-plane nodes one at a time, then the agents.
- [ ] every chart deployed on the cluster supports the new Kubernetes minor
- [ ] the ohmlab release this instance consumes runs kubectl of the same minor (`KUBECTL_VERSION` in `utils/Dockerfile`, `controller.job.kubectlImage` in `argo-cd/apps/system-upgrade/values.yaml`)

packageRules.description: A release of the ohmlab bootstrap chart was already reviewed and verified in the product repository: take minors and patches without a second review. Majors wait for a human

customManagers.description: k3s version: the Ansible inventory pin and the in-cluster system-upgrade Plan version — bumped together
Custom ARM64 mattermost image (upstream has no official arm64 build) — tracked independently of the chart, whose appVersion/digest targets amd64 only
Pinned ohmlab bootstrap chart (the registry catalog entry) in each instance's core.yaml; merging the bump is what updates the self-managed Argo CD
